name: nGZSceneGraph::cLooseOctreePartitionNode::Create
notes: Lane OI (scenegraph N1 step 2): cLooseOctreePartitionNode is our class (src/sg/cLooseOctreePartitionNode.h): cPartitionNodeT<cILooseOctreePartitionNode, cPartitionNodeImpl, cLooseOctreePartitionNodeBehaviorTraits> (the partition level over the bounded and transform levels, sg/SGNodeTemplates.h) plus the octree, 0xec bytes like the game's: the node +0, the +8 persist face, the Impl +0xc (0x60 bytes), then the octree's own words from +0x6c (the root cell, the item list head and tail, the size and half size, the free sub-partition indices and the sub-partitions, two std::vectors; static_asserts). Hooked: the director's factory is the switch; every octree is then ours, and the game's constructor 0xa50ef0 (its one caller is this factory), its destructor, its vtables 0xe6e1b4 / 0xe6e320, the template levels' vtables (behaviour 0xe6d88c, object graph 0xe6d9f8 / 0xe6db64, composition 0xe6db84 / 0xe6dcf0, transform 0xe6dd10 / 0xe6de7c, bounded 0xe6de9c / 0xe6e008, partition 0xe6e028 / 0xe6e194) and every body only they hold are never reached (their entries here, in effect through callers). Tests (tests/sg_loose_octree_partition_node.cpp; each side builds its octrees with its own factory, the original 0xa51ab0 against our Create): SG_LooseOctree_Factory (4), _Slots (64 seeds through the transform pilot's driver, tests/sg_transform_pilot.h level 3: the composition, transform and bound slots 0-72 on trees of octrees, sizes set through slot 88), _Persist (64: Read 0xa526b0 / GetTypeInfo 0xa535f0 / Write 0xa53790 through the +8 face), _Clone (64; the octree's Clone is the shared empty body 0x16a930), _Events (48: the behaviour's event slots with our connection manager in the instantiation's cell 0x10f624c), _Content (96 seeds x 40 steps) and _ContentLong (24 x 120): one octree with 12 content-node fakes (cIRenderableNode, holder slots 67 / 68, bound slots 70 / 71) and 3 sub-partition fakes (cIPartitionNode), 18 random operations per step through slots 60 (OnContentChanged), 71-75, 77-88 (insert, update, remove, add / remove partition, clear, set size, the shape, linear, ray and cull queries with strategy, nearer and filter fakes and a viewer whose view is scaled per seed) and the destructor; after every step the octree's words, every cell (walked from the root), the item list and both pools' pages and free lists compared. Floats bit-exact (the geometry is the original nGZCompGeom code on both sides; the half diagonal uses the toolchain's sqrt, as the original's _libm_sse2_sqrt_precise). Left out (the test's header): the vtable words; in the pilot the half size (words 40-42), which the constructor never writes; in the content tests the two vectors' heap words (43-48), whose sizes, capacities and elements are noted instead. The pools 0x10f620c (cells, 0x3c) and 0x10f6218 (items, 0x10) point at test regions whose page slots are fakes, so cell and item pointers compare as they are. Not driven: the iterator builders (slots 43 / 44 / 51, still game code through node_family) and Clone with content (the original's Clone is the shared empty body: a clone is never made). Original calls: nGZCompGeom (tentative names in Ghidra, lane OI): RigidInvert 0x19cd80, RigidTransformPoint 0x19c900, RigidInverseTransformPoint 0x19c6d0, RigidInverseTransformVector 0x19c390, RigidToMatrix4 0x19c1c0, BoxContainsBox 0x19d2f0, CuboidBoxInFrame 0x18ff90, CuboidBoxInRigid 0x190170, LineBoxSpan 0x19f800, Matrix4Multiply 0x1a5eb0, FrustumFromMatrix 0x1975a0, FrustumClassifyBox 0x197520, the translated cuboid shape's constructor / destructor 0x18fc10 / 0x18fce0 and its slots 0x191500 / 0x190c40; through the shared wrappers in other files, the tree code (0xa39ae0 BoundFlagChanged, 0xa39690 TransformChanged), 0x19d0d0 / 0x19be20 and the iterator builders. Mutants (tools/mutate.py, filter sg_loose_octree_partition_node, 2026-10-27): 59 on the class's bodies, 57 killed. 2 survive, equivalent: 'cull all planes' (classify even under a full mask) and 'cull child mask' (children start from no planes). FrustumClassify 0x197520 tests only the planes not yet in the mask and returns -1 for a full mask (no plane tested, nothing written). A child's loose box lies inside its parent's: its centre is a quarter of the parent's half extent out, and its half extent is half the parent's, so it reaches 3/4. Every plane the parent lies inside, the child does too. The two mutants only redo tests whose outcome is already known. Template level (SGNodeTemplates.h, --force-filter: the octree's own tests are the ones that build cPartitionNodeT<cILooseOctreePartitionNode, ...>): 6 of 6 killed (partition flag, QI, accept, slot 80, the missing event record 0x106b418 through SG_LooseOctree_EventRecord, the manager cell).
